story.title: Welcome, Leo!
paragraphs: Leo is a new trainee. Coach Mina shows him the dorm.
"This is the living room. There is a big sofa and there is a TV. Downstairs there is a kitchen. Upstairs there are four bedrooms and two bathrooms. There is a bath and there is a shower."
"Wow!" says Leo. "I like the dorm!"

paragraphs: Sora's room is small, but it's nice. There is a white wardrobe and a big mirror. There is a purple rug on the floor.
There are three posters on the wall. They are posters of the Star Academy dancers! There is a bookcase, too. Sora's books are on the shelves.

story.title: The Music Room
paragraphs: There is a music room in the dorm. There is a big black piano next to the window. There are two guitars behind the piano.
Is there a TV? No, there isn't. Are there any games? Yes, there are! There is a robot on the shelf, too. It's Max's robot. Its name is Bip!

story.title: Where Is My Lightstick?
paragraphs: It's concert day! Hana can't find her lightstick. "Is it in my bag? No, it isn't. Is it under the bed? No, it isn't!"
Sora looks in the room. There are pens and pencils on the desk. There is a grey box between the desk and the wardrobe. "Look, Hana! Your lightstick is in the box!"
